title: QBR narrative + renewal variants pack
content:
Purpose: a compact, modular QBR deck template pack that CS and AE teams can quickly adapt for both standard (growth/PLG) customers and enterprise (SLA/DED/Private) customers. Focus: storyline-first (outcomes -> evidence -> ask), renewal risk surface, action playbook, and a condensed renewal tracker to support pre-call prep.

How to use this pack:
- Pick the Narrative Variant (Standard vs Enterprise) and the Matching Slide Set.
- Replace placeholders: {CUSTOMER_NAME}, {RENEWAL_DATE}, {ARR}, {CSP_TEAM_LEAD}, {TOP_3_OKRS}.
- Prep: fill metric snapshots 7 days before QBR and attach 1–2 concrete examples (logs, transcripts, evals).

AGENDA (5–6 slides, 25–35 minutes):
1) Executive summary (1 slide): one-line customer outcome + renewal posture (Green/Amber/Red) + ask.
   - Standard prompt: "How Redwood reduced model cost per inference X% and improved median latency by Yms for {CUSTOMER_NAME}."
   - Enterprise prompt: include SLA adherence, regional failover test results, and on-prem readiness.
2) Usage & business outcomes (1–2 slides): key metrics mapped to customer goals.
3) Quality & regressions (1 slide): sample evals, drift signals, and remediation plan.
4) Reliability & ops (1 slide): incidents, MTTI/MTTR, canary rollout status.
5) Roadmap & partnership ask (1 slide): upcoming product capabilities relevant to customer + ask for commitment/renewal next step.
6) Appendix: deep-dive slides and technical artifacts (only if asked).

Slide prompts and speaker notes (concise):
- Executive summary slide: top-left: "Outcome & ROI" with a 2-line statement. Top-right: "Renewal posture" bubble (Green/Amber/Red) + renewal date. Bottom: 3 bullet asks (trial expansion, dedicated capacity, renewed 12-month commitment). Speaker note: start with the customer impact story, not the product features. 60–90s.

- Usage & business outcomes: table with (metric, baseline, current, delta, business impact). Suggested metrics: monthly inference volume, p95 latency, avg cost/token, model accuracy or eval score tied to the customer metric (e.g., intent routing accuracy). Speaker note: connect each metric to a revenue/efficiency outcome.

- Quality & regressions: show 2 example prompts + model output before/after any recommended tuning. If Enterprise, include eval harness outputs (test id, pass rate). Speaker note: be explicit about risk: if quality drifts > X% we recommend a canary rollback or a prompt patch.

- Reliability & ops: timeline of incidents (short bullets: date, impact, mitigation) and key SRE artifacts: rolling deploy status, KV cache hit rate improvements, region failover drill result. For enterprise, include "Compliance / Audit" status line.

- Roadmap & ask: two columns—Product roadmap items relevant to customer (with expected ship quarter) and Partnership asks (POC, expanded pilot, dedicated capacity). For enterprise decks add a "SLA/Support" block with suggested SLA tier and pricing anchor.

Renewal risk tracker (single-slide distillation + 1-pager tracker):
Columns: account | renewal date | ARR | renewal owner | renewal posture | top risk(s) | mitigation actions | next milestone | last contact date | notes
Example row: {CUSTOMER_NAME} | {2026-03-15} | $420k | Priya Nair | Amber | model accuracy dip, exec alignment | schedule tech deep-dive, 2-week eval, escalate to product | 2026-02-20 workshop booked | transcript attached
Notes: keep tracker live in a shared sheet but export a snapshot as the QBR appendix. Pre-QBR checklist: last contact within 14 days, updated renewal posture, top exec objective confirmed.

Playbook snippets (actionable items to include in deck and follow-up):
- If Amber (at-risk):
  1) Immediately schedule "Impact Triage" with engineering and product (owner: eng-solution).
  2) Run a 2-week dedicated eval with our Optimize recommendations (quantization/batching) and share concrete cost/latency delta by day 10.
  3) Offer short-term concession (discounted month or extended POC) while collaborating on roadmap commitment.
- If Green:
  1) Propose expansion play: additional seats, embeddings use-case, or new region rollout.
  2) Suggest co-marketing case study with customer (ask: marketing and legal).

Standard vs Enterprise variant differences (what changes in the deck):
- Standard (PLG/Growth): shorter technical appendix, emphasize usage growth, time-to-value, self-serve onboarding metrics, expansion play. Tone: pragmatic, fast cadence.
- Enterprise: include SSO/KMS audits, on-prem readiness, DSR/PII handling, contractual SLAs, escalation path, named CSM/SE/AE contacts, legal/finance ticket status. Tone: conservative, evidence-heavy.

Slide variants included in pack (for quick assembly):
- One-line outcome + renewal posture (1)
- Metric snapshot (2 versions: short, detailed)
- Customer story: before/after (with screenshots/transcript)
- Risk matrix (RAG) + prioritized mitigations
- Technical appendix: deploy topology, KV cache stats, batching config
- Pricing/contract ask page with suggested upsell anchors

Speaker prep checklist (for presenter):
- Confirm renewal owner and exec sponsor are on the attendee list.
- Clear ask with dollar figure or specific next milestone.
- Bring 1 success story + 1 risk mitigation ready.
- Prep 3-minute demo clip if relevant.

Appendix notes for engineering deep-dive (keep short, link to artifacts):
- Attach lightweight runbook for incident that affected p95 on 2025-10-12 (incident id: INC-953).
- Include one-page summary of canary rollback steps and who to ping (oncall: eng-sre rotation).

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Decide if we should include a dedicated "Cost per inference" micro-slide for every deck; some AEs think pricing talk should be separate. (Action: poll AEs w/ 24h deadline)
- Standardize the RAG thresholds across CS team (what counts as Amber vs Red for renewals). (Action: Lina to propose thresholds)
- Need legal-approved language for contract anchors in enterprise asks (Priya to sync with legal).

Quick copy snippets (for slide text / email follow-up):
- Exec summary line (positive): "Since onboarding, {CUSTOMER_NAME} reduced inference unit cost by 34% and improved median inference latency by 120ms—enabling a 1.8x increase in user throughput with the same cloud budget."
- Renewal ask (email): "We recommend a 12-month renewal with reserved capacity to secure p95 latency <= {TARGET_MS}. Can we align on a renewal decision by {DECISION_DATE}?"

Versioning and distribution:
- Keep master deck in GitHub (link above) and push a snapshot to Confluence (CONF-3421) after each major template change. Notify cs-all channel when thresholds or asks are modified.

Last edited: quick checklist before sharing with AE: replace placeholders, attach two evidentiary artifacts (eval, transcript), and run a 10-minute dry run with AE.

— end of pack —

(Working doc: expect iterative updates, this is a living template. Add missing slide variants to the GitHub deck PR and reference CONF-3421 for long-form guidance.)
